title: From Selling Ice Pops to a $365 Million Deal
description:
Canelo Álvarez signed a deal worth at least 365 million dollars with DAZN in October 2018.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Canelo Álvarez: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canelo_%C3%81lvarez
- CNBC: Boxing champion Canelo signs the richest deal in sports history with new $365 million contract: https://www.cnbc.com/2018/10/18/boxing-champion-canelo-signs-the-richest-deal-in-sports-history-with-new-365-million-contract.html
- CBS Sports: Canelo Alvarez signs most lucrative contract in sports history with DAZN: https://www.cbssports.com/boxing/news/canelo-alvarez-signs-most-lucrative-contract-in-sports-history-with-dazn-to-stream-fights
- MedioTiempo: Antes de los guantes, esto hacia Canelo Alvarez: https://www.mediotiempo.com/mas-deportes/box/antes-de-los-guantes-esto-hacia-canelo-alvarez-antes-de-convertirse-en-boxeador
- Azteca Jalisco: La ruta de camiones donde el Canelo vendia paletas: https://www.aztecajalisco.com/deportes/esta-era-la-ruta-camiones-donde-el-canelo-alvarez-vendia-paletas

From the cited pages: DAZN signed Alvarez to a five-year, 11-fight deal worth a minimum of $365 million on October 17, 2018 (CNBC, CBS, Wikipedia); he turned pro at 15 (Wikipedia); as a child he sold paletas (ice pops) from the family business and on a bus route in Guadalajara (MedioTiempo, Azteca Jalisco); Sportico's 2025 list ranked him second at $137 million (Wikipedia). Not financial advice.

loop: So next time someone laughs at your small start, remember:
first_comment: Would you sell ice pops for a shot at 365 million dollars? 👇

scenes.narration: Canelo Álvarez signed a 365 million dollar DAZN deal.
But as a kid, he sold ice pops on a bus route.
Then he turned pro at age 15.
Reports called the 2018 deal the richest in sports history. In 2025, he was the second highest-paid athlete: 137 million dollars.
Not bad for a kid who just sold ice pops.
